about.description: eTPLUS gives native on-chain access to TPLUS, a short-duration self-liquidating private credit strategy managed by Epoch Digital and targeting 8% net APY (Ember reports a 9.73% target). The portfolio spans bank payment receivables, payment processing receivables and insured trade receivables, each backed by contractual cash flows with insurance, over-collateralisation or credit enhancement; weighted average duration is under 45 days with no asset-level leverage. Deposits are allocated into zTPLUS, Zodiac's permissionless wrapper of the fund, and depositors receive eTPLUS, an ERC-4626 receipt representing proportional ownership of the vault. Deposits are synchronous and capped at 25,000,000 USDC per chain; withdrawals run on a 3-day period with a 10.84-share minimum (~USD 10,000) and a 0.05% redemption fee.
